changelog: **Document requirements get a review chain (#1859):** `DocumentRequirement` gains `approvalMode` (`NONE` default | `SINGLE` | `CHAIN`), `validityDays` and `reviewerRoles` (ordered steps, role `MENTOR` | `ADMIN` | `COMPANY` | `EXTERNAL`); `Document` gains `reviewStatus` (`PENDING` | `APPROVED` | `REJECTED` | `EXPIRED`), `validFrom`, `validUntil`; new `DocumentReview` (one row per step, `orgId`, in `TENANT_MODELS`). Completion stays derived: `isSatisfied()` (`src/lib/documentReview.ts`) — under `NONE` a file attached is still a requirement met (no org changes behaviour), under `SINGLE`/`CHAIN` only an `APPROVED` document inside its validity window counts. `POST /api/documents/[id]/review` decides the current step (guarded `updateMany`; out of order → 409 `out_of_order`, double submit → 409, wrong reviewer → 403, a rejection needs a reason) — the owner's active mentor, an org admin or the owner's company per step, never the owner. An `EXTERNAL` step is sent by an admin or the owner's mentor (`POST …/review/invite`, category `document-review`) and decided at `/document-review/[token]` with no account; the token answers only for that step and is cleared once used. A rejection notifies the owner with the reason and re-opens the requirement; the cron's `expireDocuments()` flips `APPROVED` documents past `validUntil` to `EXPIRED` exactly once (owner + admins notified) before the missing-document reminder runs. Review queue on `/admin/documents` and the mentor and company dashboards; status badge and rejection reason on the document list; chain fields in the requirement form. Deploy runs `prisma/backfill-document-reviews.mjs` (PENDING with no review step → APPROVED; idempotent).

en: Document requirements can now require approval — by a mentor, the programme, the company or an external reviewer by e-mail link, in order — and can expire after a set number of days.
tr: Belge gereklilikleri artık onay isteyebilir — mentor, program, şirket ya da e-posta bağlantısıyla harici bir onaylayıcı tarafından, sırayla — ve belirli bir gün sonra süresi dolabilir.
de: Dokumentanforderungen können jetzt eine Freigabe verlangen – durch Mentor, Programm, Unternehmen oder eine externe Person per E-Mail-Link, der Reihe nach – und nach einer festgelegten Anzahl Tage ablaufen.
